messages:
Ria Banerjee: FYI Equinox (reseller) flagged VAT on INV-2026-1984. They charged EU VAT to a VAT-exempt NGO customer. Need guidance on credit vs refund and partner settlement impact. @Tom Hsu
Tom Hsu: Can you paste the invoice snippet and the customer tax status?
Ria Banerjee: Invoice lines:
INV-2026-1984
- Usage: 950,000 tokens @ $0.00075 = $712.50
- VAT (applied) 20% = +$142.50
- Total = $855.00
Customer: Global Relief Network (GRN) — has VAT-exempt certificate on file (VAT-EU-EX-778). Partner applied tax in error during settlement sync.
Accounting Bot: Auto-validate: customer VAT exemption active as of 2025-11-01. Tax applied after partner settlement import on 2026-02-12. Flagged ticket FIN-4420. Recommend: issue customer credit for the VAT amount $142.50 and debit partner settlement for tax amount. GL suggestion: 4-2210 for customer credits, 2-3300 for partner payable adjustments.
Lucas Meyer: Is this a cash refund case? Customer already paid via card. Standard policy is credit memo unless customer requests immediate refund. Also need to reverse VAT remittance if we already paid it to tax authority — check remittance status.
Partner Ops Bot: Partner settlement for Equinox (payout 2026-02-15) included tax line TX-2026-0215. Remittance pending (not yet paid). Suggest adjusting partner payout before remittance.
Tom Hsu: Good. So action plan: 1) Issue credit memo CM-2026-1230 for $142.50 to GRN; 2) Create partner debit ADJ-2026-3005 for $142.50 against Equinox settlement; 3) If customer requests cash refund, accounting will process after credit memo.
Ria Banerjee: Draft customer note: "We identified that VAT was incorrectly applied to invoice INV-2026-1984. A credit memo for the VAT amount ($142.50) has been issued to your account. No action required; if you prefer a refund, reply and we'll process it." Keeps neutral.
Accounting Bot: CM-2026-1230 created and queued. ADJ-2026-3005 created and will adjust next settlement batch. FIN-4420 updated. GL entries recommended.
Tom Hsu: Iris, can you OK the GL mapping and approve non-cash correction? @Iris Patel (cced offline)
Ria Banerjee: Noting to tax team to halt remittance TX-2026-0215 until partner adjustment clears. Tagging OPS to confirm.
Partner Ops Bot: Noted. Partner settlement hold placed. Will reconcile before remittance window closes.
Lucas Meyer: approving credit memo route. If remittance had already posted, we'd need to escalate for reclaim. Since it's pending, partner debit is sufficient.
Ria Banerjee: I'll send the customer note once CM posts and confirm with partner ops when the settlement is adjusted. Closing loop after remittance cleared. :white_check_mark:
